task.title: Bound dev VM deploy deadline with lease-safe failure handling

scope.owned_layer: Bounded dev VM deploy command deadline, direct SSH process group termination on timeout, and lease contract tests
not_changing: Existing lease guard verification and heartbeat renewal contract
Source Ingestion reconcile-only default posture and no-proof writes policy

behavioral_proof.deadline_hierarchy: Job timeout (30m / 1800s) > deploy command deadline (DEV_DEPLOY_DEADLINE_SECONDS default 1200s / 20m) ensures clean command-level timeout and lease teardown before runner cancellation
behavioral_proof.process_group_termination: Direct SSH execution runs in an isolated session and terminates all processes in its process group on deadline timeout
behavioral_proof.lease_quarantine_preservation: Command timeout triggers exit code 75 and guard failure recording, stopping heartbeat renewal and preserving lease quarantine until TTL
behavioral_proof.no_watchdog_or_retry_queue: Enforced synchronously in direct execution wrapper without introducing secondary retry queues or watchdogs
